Signature.Documentation: This test case tests a CB-AdES-B-B signature built on an untagged COSE_Sign1 structure with attached payload. Apart from the protected header parameters alg, CWT Claims (enclosing iat) and x5chain, the implementation shall add the protected x5t header parameter (label 34) as a COSE_CertHash array whose first element shall be the COSE identifier of SHA-256 (-16) and whose second element shall be the SHA-256 digest of the DER-encoded signing certificate (clause 5.1.7). No other optional component shall be present. The x5chain header parameter shall be a protected header parameter. At least the signing certificate shall be included in x5chain; the certificates needed for building the certification path should also be included.
